name: Out Local
focus: Paramedic practitioner cases, workup and extended-care decisions

episodes.title: Ep 3. The Kid With a Rash
episodes.notes: Paediatric presentations are a challenging cohort, not only do they require a detailed approach, that typically appear miserable when afflicted with an illness. Skin conditions and eruptions can be a muddy process, in this episode we chat about using some basic pattern recognition alongside more detailed takes to assist the evaluation of the kid with a rash.

episodes.title: Patient workup considerations for the paramedic practitioner
episodes.notes: The clinical assessment is the cornerstone skill every clinician needs to master to make meaningful decisions for their patients. Michael and Aaron discuss the lessons they have over their careers that have shaped their patient approach and how these reflections have lead to more fruitful patient encounters.

episodes.title: Episode 1: An introduction to the Paramedic Practitioner
episodes.notes: Welcome to Out Local. In this episode we chat about the Paramedic Practitioner role posed to entry the Australian ambulance environment, why it has come about, who is offering education opportunities and more.
